title: Elevation, in feet, water year October 1948 to September 1949
notes: Daily grid, upright. Days with no value are printed as "-" and typed as empty cells. Typewriter face in which 6 and 8 (and worn 5/9) look alike. Stray tick mark above Oct. 11 value (40.12), not typed.

notes: Upright. "-" printed for no value typed as empty. Plus and minus signs kept as printed. Labels "Sept.30" printed without a space. Summary rows "Calendar year 1948" and "Water year 1948-49" are set off by rules and typed as body rows. Header "elevation" printed lower-case.
